patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero section with a large, bold heading and call-to-action on the left, balanced by a complex, multi-layered 3D illustration on the right.
Alternating dark and light background sections (black/dark blue and white) create clear visual separation, with vibrant multi-color gradients and illustrations providing key accents.

Prominent, oversized sans-serif headings are used for section titles, creating strong visual hierarchy, complemented by smaller, legible body text and very small, uppercase labels for categories or metadata.
The hero's multi-layered 3D illustration exhibits a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the scroll, while content sections appear to reveal or fade into view as they enter the viewport.
Client logos are presented in a full-width, horizontally scrolling carousel directly below the hero, establishing trust and social proof early on.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky navigation bar that remains visible at the top of the viewport throughout scrolling. The hero section features an interactive or video element with a complex, layered 3D graphic that uses a parallax scrolling effect, where the graphic moves at a different rate than the page content. Content sections are revealed with a subtle animation, such as a fade-up or slide-in, as they scroll into view, likely managed by a scroll-triggered animation library like locomotive-scroll.

Section backgrounds alternate between deep dark tones and clean white, providing strong contrast for content. Text is primarily white on dark backgrounds and dark on white backgrounds. Call-to-action buttons feature a solid dark background with white text, maintaining a consistent, high-contrast appearance.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with regular weight body text and very small, uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners dominate, with buttons having a very subtle, almost imperceptible rounding.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy spacing in the hero and between major sections, transitioning to a balanced density within content grids and text blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a complex, multi-layered 3D illustration in the hero section, which subtly parallaxes with scroll, immediately conveys a sense of sophisticated technology and modern design. This visual depth and dynamic interaction set it apart from typical static hero images.
